title: Practice jars Bellarmino: countless Marian altars bear her name without her tomb or relics
source_text: XXII. Sed cum ista Bellarmini Doctrina & observatione non satis quadrat praxis Ecclesiae Romanae. Nam quam innumera altaria Beatae Virgini in ea dicata sunt, & de ejus nomine vocantur, de qua tamen non sunt ejus tumulus vel sepulchrum, imo in quibus nullae servari dicuntur illius reliquiae?
pass_a_gloss: But with that doctrine and observation of Bellarmine the praxis of the Roman Church does not sufficiently square. For how innumerable are the altars in it dedicated to the Blessed Virgin and called by her name, of which nevertheless they are not her tumulus or sepulcher—nay, in which none of her relics are said to be kept?
pass_b_english: Roman practice undercuts Bellarmino’s tomb-only rule.
Marian altars everywhere take her name without her sepulcher or relics.
